text:
EPIC COMPLETE: 28 of 28 children closed. The dead intake vocabulary is reachable and the records are wired to code.

What the epic set out to fix (D1-D10), and what is now true:
- D5 'no code reads any source-manifest.json': LegacyManifest lifts the legacy shape to thin v2 and Verify.verify reads it on the main path for Sherlock, Friends and Memento.
- D7 'probe.verifyInput compares a CALLER-SUPPLIED checksum': renamed declaredIdentityAgrees, which is what it does; MediaProbe.joinVerified added for the case that actually verifies.
- The forged film edition at FilmFestivalRecallMapping.scala:148-168 has a lawful alternative: AxisKind.AnnotationTimeline and PresentationAxis.annotationTable exist, so a timed annotation table no longer has to pose as an edition.
- The Sherlock crosswalk existed three times; TimebaseRepair now reads docs/data/sherlock/timebase-repair.json and builds real ClockRepairs, and the test named for that file now opens it.
- Python corpus constants are declared in a descriptor rather than transcribed, with configure() on four scorers.

Approach held: readers first, vocabulary as forced by real corpora. Memento broke the schema three times (Excel day origin 0 vs 1, artifact key id vs path, nested paths) and each break changed the design -- which is what revision 1 could not have learned, having specified six vocabulary families before opening a workbook.

Scheduled reviews: six planned, of which the three Fable 5.1 slice reviews (P2b-ii, P3 SegmentLink, P5 ClockRepair) were NEVER DELIVERED -- Fable usage credits exhausted, an account-level limit no retry clears. This is an honest gap in the plan as written. The compensating evidence is the P8 cold review, which covered the whole subsystem including all three slices, found one blocker and three majors, and was run by the default model. Lesson recorded on the P8 bead: buy coldness, not a frontier model.

Nothing here admits a corpus, commits a Friends or Memento artifact, or changes any inference, default or published number: tools/recall-study is 397 insertions and 0 deletions, and configure() has no caller outside the tests.

Gate at sign-off: exit 0, 24/24 modules, 2466 tests, 0 failed, 0 errors, scalafmt clean. Branch solo/intake-contract, head b4ad7d20. Evidence: docs/plans/2026-09-17-intake-contract-evidence.md. ADR: docs/adr/0018-annotation-intake-contract.md.

NOT DONE, and deliberately out of scope: the pipeline normalizes into memory and stops. Nothing serializes Segmentation/SegmentLink/Coded, so each consumer still re-reads raw files with its own logic and each new corpus needs a hand-written intake object. A canonical emission format is the natural successor epic and needs an ADR before code (SD5).
